name: Zajach'ja guba
source: Harelip is a middle—aged man, tall and strongly built, with short-cropped dark hair and an indifferent look. A Band-Aid is stuck on the bridge of his nose, and his upper lip is split by a characteristic scar, which was the reason for his nickname in the village. He is dressed like a typical bandit, in a thick leather jacket, with a gold chain around his neck visible in the open collar. He wears winter shoes and gloves. He holds a dark purse in his right hand. He is often seen smoking.
